scope.purpose: Classify every independently decidable media/files acceptance requirement without treating an unexecuted source test or candidate as a pass.

issues.title: Implement per-site Wikidot favicon and platform icon settings

subrows.acceptance: Accept only same-site local-file sources or exact site-owned imported HTTPS routes; reject arbitrary redirects and unsafe URL forms.
subrows.reason: Deepwell validates before commit and Framerail applies the same route projection policy.
existing_tests: framerail/tests/site-icon-source.test.js::imported site icons redirect only to site-owned Wikidot resources
framerail/tests/site-icon-source.test.js::local site icons redirect only to same-origin file routes

subrows.acceptance: Project the favicon and three iOS declarations in the evidenced order without an unconditional data URL icon.
subrows.reason: The favicon/iOS declaration helper and route handlers exist with focused Node coverage.

subrows.acceptance: Project the configured Windows 8 tile through the exact live head declaration and local route instead of storing an unused setting.
subrows.reason: The settings model and admin field prove that a Windows tile slot exists, but the frozen evidence and read-only public probes do not show a configured positive public-head shape or its site-local route. A source or test change would have to invent the meta declaration or pathname.
missing_evidence: GET and HEAD behavior for that route
same-site unconfigured negative control bound to the positive capture

subrows.acceptance: Upload or download icon bytes into local ownership, atomically bind one icon slot, and define replacement, deletion, MIME, size, SVG/script, and failure behavior.
subrows.reason: The panel proves local upload and URL download controls but does not freeze the slot-to-blob transaction or its edge policies.
missing_evidence: existing URL download redirect and content policy

subrows.acceptance: Serve a locally owned icon with exact status, MIME, byte hash, missing state, and anonymous visibility from the exact merged candidate.
subrows.reason: Route source exists, but local icon bytes and their ownership relation are runtime state.

subrows.acceptance: Observe the icon request and declaration before and after setting changes, reload, and client navigation without a stale initial or settled icon.
subrows.reason: This is temporal browser and cache behavior and cannot be proved from source or a settled screenshot.

subrows.acceptance: Render the frozen external f=image source as the exact Wikidot image-container, img.image, width, alt, and owned host projection.
subrows.reason: The current FTML pin and Deepwell public preview test exact-compare the frozen G06 case.

subrows.acceptance: Resolve a source-less current-page attachment after ACL and serve its evidenced original/resized URL and exact blob revision.
subrows.reason: FTML exposes an implicit attachment descriptor, but Wikijump has no /local--resized-images WWS route or source test binding latest visible file revision to the served resize.
missing_source: revision-bound resized asset service and WWS route
source-level negative controls for missing, deleted, private, cross-site, and traversal targets

subrows.acceptance: Extend spacing, tab, NBSP, unqualified width, size alias, quoted filename, and float spelling behavior beyond the frozen G06 case.
subrows.reason: The issue comment proposes these red cases, but the required two positive and two negative live boundary observations are not frozen for each widened grammar rule.
missing_evidence: live grammar boundary matrix for every widened token form

subrows.acceptance: Verify initial and settled natural dimensions, computed float width/alignment, load/error state, click target, responsive behavior, and exact file request identity.
subrows.reason: These claims depend on the exact image bytes, WWS response, CSS cascade, and browser intervals.

issues.title: Match centered Wikidot =image width and whitespace forms

subrows.acceptance: Render the frozen one-space and multiple-space external centered image forms as exact aligncenter image-container DOM with width and owned host projection.
subrows.reason: The current FTML pin and Deepwell public preview test both exact G61 variants.

subrows.acceptance: Resolve a source-less centered current-page attachment after ACL and serve the evidenced original/resized blob revision.
subrows.reason: The same missing permission-bound resized asset route as #776 remains; centered static DOM alone cannot prove served attachment behavior.
missing_source: revision-bound resized asset service and WWS route

subrows.acceptance: Extend centered-image handling to tab, NBSP, unqualified width, size aliases, quoted filename, and other proposed forms.
subrows.reason: Only the one-space and multiple-space G61 source forms are sealed; the proposed wider grammar lacks the required live boundary controls.
missing_evidence: live grammar boundary matrix for every widened token form

subrows.acceptance: Verify initial and settled natural dimensions, computed center/width, load/error, click target, responsive behavior, and exact file request identity.
subrows.reason: The exact bytes, WWS response, theme cascade, and visible intervals exist only in the final candidate.

issues.title: Complete Wikidot Files and FlickrGallery module contracts

ownership_boundary.current_ftml_fact: Module::Runtime is typed only for closer-bearing unknown modules whose body starts on the next physical line.
ownership_boundary.frozen_case_fact: Files and FlickrGallery are closer-less argument-free own-line heads, so the exact existing shim remains necessary and must not widen.

subrows.acceptance: Match the frozen argument-free Files PagePreview empty wrapper, text, refresh script identity, and manage-attachments anchor.
subrows.reason: The exact closer-less source shape is expanded before FTML and public PagePreview coverage binds the frozen result.

subrows.acceptance: Bind the saved empty wrapper and refresh script to one page identity, while denied or missing pages reveal no page or file identity and query files only after Page:View.
subrows.reason: The renderer uses AuthorizedPageSelector before FileService::get_all and the integration test covers public saved and denied private states.

subrows.acceptance: Render 1/N file rows with exact name, href, size, type, date, user, order, pagination, duplicate-looking name, Unicode, deleted, and revision behavior.
subrows.reason: No frozen nonempty Files row DOM or ordering/pagination contract was found. The current renderer deliberately leaves HasFiles unsupported instead of fabricating empty output.

subrows.acceptance: Open and operate the live manage-attachments panel from the emitted link with correct actor and page context.
subrows.reason: The frozen HTML proves the anchor but not panel transition, actor matrix, failure, or intermediate browser states; Framerail has no filesClick compatibility handler.

subrows.acceptance: Match the argument-free PagePreview no-photo wrapper and escaped literal diagnostics without a provider request.
subrows.reason: The exact frozen source shape and title are rendered by the focused public PagePreview test.

subrows.acceptance: Implement documented required arguments, provider no-photo/failure/results, sanitized URLs and HTML, SSRF, timeout, size, CSP, and browser states.
subrows.reason: The saved capture is a client hybrid placeholder; no provider result, failure response, network boundary, or settled browser contract is frozen.
missing_evidence: loading, error, and settled browser intervals

subrows.acceptance: Apply page permission before file metadata and serve /local--files bytes, MIME, range, and ETag from the exact active blob identity without non-disclosing leaks.
subrows.reason: Deepwell file reads are parent-page authorized and WWS rechecks page and file metadata before streaming the s3_hash object.

subrows.acceptance: Prove upload, delete, rename, and revision changes produce the next authorized file inventory and exact blob bytes without stale counts, rows, validators, or cache entries.
subrows.reason: Mutation services and serving seams exist, but this stateful cross-process claim needs one exact DB/files/cache candidate.

subrows.acceptance: Invalidate compiled output from before the Files renderer landed and rerender it under the final source-frozen renderer identity.
subrows.reason: Files rendering landed after deepwell-render/v2, but the renderer epoch is still v2.

issues.title: Match Wikidot EmbedVideo provider fallback, sanitization, and browser lifecycle

subrows.acceptance: Consume only FTML typed EmbedVideo requirements; reject missing, duplicate, or foreign markers and keep code, raw, comment, HTML, and generated owners inert.
subrows.reason: The consumer reads the typed requirement sidecar and exact marker once; public tests cover marker forgery and inert owners without raw-source or final-HTML syntax recognition.

subrows.acceptance: Render only frozen YouTube and Acast iframe descriptors with safe host, path, attributes, and dimensions; fail closed for unsupported or unsafe payloads.
subrows.reason: The typed provider consumer allowlists exact origins and paths and public tests cover allowed, unsupported, malformed, credentialed, port, javascript, data, and event-handler cases.

subrows.acceptance: Permit only the two evidenced frame origins and grant no script authority to authored media payloads.
subrows.reason: The Framerail CSP source and focused Node test bind exactly YouTube and Acast frame-src origins.

subrows.acceptance: Bind saved output to the final provider policy and renderer semantics so pre-policy compiled output is not reused.
subrows.reason: The existing preview/saved test asserts deepwell-render/v2, while later provider and other renderer changes remain under the same epoch.

subrows.acceptance: Verify PagePreview and saved initial response, iframe creation, request, load/error, resize, focus, navigation, cleanup, and fail-closed no-request intervals.
subrows.reason: Network policy, CSP, browser focus, and temporal cleanup require the exact production candidate and cannot be inferred from final DOM.

issues.title: Implement Wikidot Gallery file selection, viewer DOM, and browser behavior

subrows.acceptance: Return the exact Error selecting page block for the frozen no-page Gallery while code and prose owners remain inert.
subrows.reason: Deepwell consumes only the typed Gallery requirement and public PagePreview coverage binds the exact no-page and owner boundary.

subrows.acceptance: Return the exact no-images error for a visible saved page with no image attachments.
subrows.reason: The current-page integration test starts from an empty saved page and exact-checks the frozen error contract.

subrows.acceptance: Select visible current-page images or exact site/page/file-owned explicit entries only after page ACL; exclude non-image, arbitrary, cross-site, missing, and private entries.
subrows.reason: VisibleFileLoader checks the parent page before file and revision queries, and integration tests cover current, private, explicit owned, cross-site, arbitrary, and non-image cases.

subrows.acceptance: Bind size, order, viewer defaults, accepted values, aliases, invalid values, duplicates, and empty occurrences to evidence-backed source tests.
subrows.reason: The implementation accepts a documented option set, but existing tests exercise only thumbnail and do not source-bind the full matrix or last-occurrence behavior.

subrows.acceptance: Emit the evidenced gallery-box, gallery-item, table, optional with-lb anchor, img class, escaped alt, and no script or Wikijump identifier.
subrows.reason: The renderer unit test exact-compares the frozen static thumbnail shape and negative script/identifier conditions.

subrows.acceptance: Use exact revision-bound original and resized blob identities and invalidate both after upload, delete, rename, or revision.
subrows.reason: Gallery currently uses the original local-file URL for both link and image, and WWS exposes no resized-image route.

subrows.acceptance: Match viewer open, close, next, previous, keyboard, focus, overlay, loading, error, custom link, and every intermediate state.
subrows.reason: The frozen corpus proves static with-lb markup but not the interaction timeline; no generic lightbox may substitute for Wikidot behavior.

subrows.acceptance: Invalidate compiled output from before Gallery resolution landed and bind the next read to the final renderer epoch and exact file revision.
subrows.reason: Gallery rendering landed after deepwell-render/v2, but the epoch remains v2 and no test proves old compiled output is rejected.

subrows.acceptance: Verify initial and settled thumbnail request, natural dimensions, load/error, viewer lifecycle, navigation, focus, and client navigation against exact candidate blobs.
subrows.reason: This claim spans Deepwell, WWS, Framerail, bytes, CSS, and temporal browser behavior.

issues.title: Page file upload fails before blob commit

subrows.acceptance: Return successful and failed multipart actions without an arbitrary File object in SvelteKit's serialized payload.
subrows.reason: Source now returns withFiles({ form, res }), which addresses the historical cause, but no current test drives the real action through SvelteKit serialization.

subrows.acceptance: Check Page:Edit, then blob_upload, presigned PUT, and file_create in order, and expose the created file only after relation commit.
subrows.reason: The source order is present and presigned HTTP errors are covered, but only one exact task-owned DB/files candidate can prove the transaction and next read.

subrows.acceptance: Require parent-page edit permission and exact site/page/blob ownership; reject client authority over another pending blob.
subrows.reason: blob_upload now derives page ownership from the trusted request context, the database enforces scoped-or-unscoped shape, and typed page finalization rejects another actor, page, site, or unscoped pending blob without exposing whether the token exists. The public endpoint case proves the successful file_create response and subsequent page_get_files/file_get bytes, with direct database access limited to supplemental ownership-persistence, fixture-setup, and cleanup assertions.
existing_tests: install/local/wikidot-verification/tests/corpus-import-attachments.test.mjs::materializeCorpusRowAttachments binds pending uploads to the trusted page context

subrows.acceptance: On presign, PUT, timeout, or file_create failure, create no file relation, leave no public route, cancel pending state, and preserve list/cache state.
subrows.reason: The real page file create and replacement flows now share a pending upload lifecycle that calls blob_cancel in a separate JSON-RPC request after PUT, file_create, or file_edit failure and preserves the original error. Focused Node cases prove call order, exactly one cleanup, trusted context forwarding, and no cancel after success; the Deepwell ownership case proves failed commits expose no file relation and owner cancellation removes pending state and its temporary object while permanent content-addressed objects retain their existing semantics. A task-owned runtime candidate still must prove transport timeout, cache, and object-store behavior.

subrows.acceptance: Handle a second same-name upload, non-ASCII filename, empty name, and override name according to observed Wikidot policy.
subrows.reason: The historical run failed before the first file existed, so it observed no duplicate, Unicode, or naming policy. The issue itself requires live evidence before fixing these expectations.

subrows.acceptance: Verify select, upload, loading, error, success, list refresh, reload, exact download bytes, double submit, and absence of HTTP 500 or blank action responses.
subrows.reason: This is a stateful temporal workflow spanning SvelteKit, Deepwell, object storage, WWS, and browser UI.
